companies.owner_policy: Use completed orders after refunds, excluding tax and shipping. Notify Commerce when the total changes by at least $100 or any channel contributes at least $80 in absolute terms. Ignore smaller complete movements. If the population or period coverage is incomplete, do not estimate the total; route the gap to Data Operations.

companies.brief: Monitor weighted resolution-SLA miss rate by support tier.
companies.owner_policy: Use eligible resolved tickets and weight the SLA miss rate by ticket count, not by averaging tier percentages. Notify Support Operations when the weighted current miss rate is at least 12% or its absolute change is at least 4 percentage points. If any eligible tier is missing, do not estimate a rate; route to the Data Steward. Keep rate and mix effects descriptive, not causal.

companies.brief: Monitor late completed shipments across fulfillment warehouses.

If the selected source disagrees with another source on whether it measures shipments or order promises, investigate the definition before routing a business alert.

companies.brief: Monitor additive expansion, contraction, new-logo, and churn MRR movements.
companies.owner_policy: Use signed monthly recurring-revenue movements from subscription change records. Notify Subscription Operations when net MRR changes by at least $50 or any expansion/contraction segment contributes at least $60. Ignore smaller complete movements. Report expansion and contraction as accounting contributions, not causes; do not substitute gross bookings for signed subscription movements.
